start.title: Roof Under Snow
start.text: A widow named Edda is standing in the street staring up at her roof. The snow on the north slope is nearly waist-deep and one beam has begun to bow. Her ladder is buried behind the shed.

choices.text: Clear the roof before the beam gives

buckets.flavourText: You work from the eaves inward, moving the weight evenly. The beam rises a finger's width as the last heavy slab slides off.
You clear most of the load before the beam cracks. It holds, but the room beneath will need bracing.
The snow is heavier than it looks and the ladder shifts under you.

choices.text: Help her brace the room from inside instead
Tell her to fetch a carpenter

slip.title: A Bad Step
slip.text: The ladder kicks sideways. You catch the gutter with one hand while a sheet of snow comes down around you.

buckets.flavourText: You swing back onto the ladder and climb down with considerably more respect for the roof.
You drop the last few feet into a drift, bruised more in pride than body.

brace_inside.title: Posts and Wedges
brace_inside.text: Inside, the problem looks worse but simpler. Edda has timber, a saw, and no spare hands.

buckets.flavourText: You place two posts beneath the load and wedge them tight. The roof can wait for morning.
The brace is ugly but sound enough for one night.
The first post slips and gouges the floor. Edda wisely suggests waiting for the carpenter.

saved.title: A Roof Still Standing
saved.text: Edda presses a heel of cheese into your hand and refuses to take it back. The house creaks once as the wind shifts, then settles.

braced.title: One Night Bought
braced.text: The roof is not fixed, but it will survive the night. In winter, sometimes that is the only victory available.

leave.title: Someone Else's Ladder
leave.text: You leave Edda to find the carpenter. By evening, three neighbours are on the roof with shovels.
